blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: In-context learning is usually analyzed as if the examples in the prompt were sampled before the learner is chosen. In deployed systems they are not: examples are retrieved, filtered, re-ranked, edited, and repeatedly tested after seeing the query and the data store. We formalize this gap by treating prompt construction as adaptive data analysis through a conditional stochastic-kernel calculus. Our main quantity is the context capacity, the mutual information or approximate max-information between the data store and the final prompt transcript. For any frozen in-context learner and any adaptive context pipeline with capacity $κ$, we prove a finite-sample context generalization bound of order $\sqrt{κ/k}$, where $k$ is the number of selected examples whose losses form the reported score. We prove a matching lower bound, whose constant is exact when $\log k\llκ\ll k$, and derive two PAC-Bayesian retrieval rules: a first-order Gibbs rule that charges data-dependent candidate gates their prior mass, and a self-normalized second-order rule. On Banking77 with 64 retrieval recipes and two model families, the certificates hold in all 24,000 resampled selection events, and from 64 (Qwen2.5-7B) or 128 (GPT-4.1-mini) reused validation queries the Gibbs rule certifies a risk below the zero-shot error in over 99% of validation draws. Finally, we instantiate the theory for Bayesian linear in-context regression, including an order-statistics analysis of query-aligned top-$k$ Gaussian retrieval. The results separate context quality from context certification: longer or more relevant contexts improve risk only when the procedure used to choose them is stable enough for selected-context evidence to transfer.
blocks.zh: 通常在选择学习者之前,就对内容内学习进行分析,仿佛对提示中的例子进行了抽样。 在部署的系统中,它们不是:实例被检索、过滤、重新排序、编辑,并在看到查询和数据库后反复测试。 我们通过有条件的分泌-内核微积分,将快速构建视为适应性数据分析,从而将这一差距正式化。 我们的主要数量是数据存储和最后及时记录之间的上下文容量、相互信息或大致最大信息。 对于任何被冻结的文字学习者以及任何具有美元能力的适应性环境管道,我们证明一种有限-实例的上下文概括,以$\sqrt%/k}美元为限,其中以美元作为选定实例的数量,其损失构成报告的得分。 我们证明一个匹配的下限, 当 $\log k\llκ\ll k$ 时它的常数是准确的, 并得出两个 PAC- Bayesian 检索规则: 一阶 Gibbs 规则, 要求依赖数据的候选者打开其先前的质量, 以及自常态的 二阶规则 。 在有64个检索食谱和两个模型家族的Banking77上,证书在所有24 000个再模拟选择活动中都持有,从64个(Quen2.5-7B)或128个(GPT-4.1-mini)再利用验证中询问Gibbs规则证明在99%以上的验证抽取中低于零发误差的风险。 最后,我们即时分析贝叶斯线性内文回归的理论,包括对查询相通的上-美元高斯检索的顺序-统计分析. 结果将上下文质量与上下文认证区分开来:只有当选择上下文的程序足够稳定,可供选定上下文证据转移时,长期或更相关的上下文才会增加风险.

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en: Large language models and tabular foundation models built on attention architectures [ 41 ] can adapt at inference time from examples supplied in the prompt [ 7 , 19 ] . A growing theory explains when transformers can implement least squares, gradient descent, ridge regression, Bayesian inference, or related meta-algorithms in context [ 1 , 42 , 21 , 29 , 28 , 5 ] . This line of work typically starts from a clean statistical abstraction: a prompt is a sample from a task distribution, possibly corrupted by a fixed retrieval noise model [ 20 ] .
blocks.zh: 基于关注架构的大型语言模型和表格式基础模型[41]可以在推论时间从迅速[7,19]提供的例子中适应. 一个不断增长的理论解释,当变压器能够在上下文中执行最小的方格,梯度下降,山脊回归,贝叶斯推论,或相关的元算法[1,42,21,29,28,5]. 本行工作一般从干净的统计抽象开始:一个提示是一个任务分布的样本,可能被固定检索噪声模型[20]腐蚀.

blocks.en: The clean abstraction is not how prompts are built in practice. Retrieval-augmented generation, few-shot prompting, data-centric prompt engineering, and agentic workflows select demonstrations after seeing a query and a large data store. The selected examples may have passed through embedding search, label filters, re-rankers, hand edits, repeated validation, and model-in-the-loop retries. The context is therefore an adaptive statistic of the same data on which it is judged. This creates a distinct failure mode that we call context overfitting : the prompt looks good on the examples or validation interactions used to select it, but its deployment risk is worse than the selected-context score suggests.
blocks.zh: 干净的抽象不是在实际中建立诱因的方式. 检索增强的生成,少发提示,以数据为中心的即时工程,代理工作流程在看到查询和大数据存储后选择演示. 所选的例子可能已经通过嵌入搜索,标签过滤,重新排序,手编辑,重复验证,以及模型在loop重试. 因此,这一背景是对其判断的相同数据的适应性统计。 这造成了一种明显的失败模式,我们称之为上下文过度匹配 : 在用于选择它的例子或验证互动上, 提示看起来很好, 但是它的部署风险比选中的文本分数所显示的要差 。

blocks.en:
Our answer is deliberately architecture-agnostic. We model the transformer, language model, or tabular foundation model as a frozen map from a prompt transcript to a loss function. All adaptivity is charged to the prompt construction pipeline. The resulting theory does not explain why a transformer implements a good inner learner; instead, it explains when the empirical evidence used to choose or evaluate a context remains statistically valid.
We do not claim that adaptive retrieval is bad for prediction. Good retrieval can reduce approximation error and improve the deployed predictor. The claim is narrower: selected-context performance is not automatically valid evidence of deployment risk unless the selection process is stable or the final prompt is evaluated on fresh data. The diagnosis, the κ / k \sqrt{\kappa/k} price, covers every adaptive pipeline; certificates cover pipelines whose data-dependent choices are logged, finite, or randomized, and Theorem 4.4 and Remark 4.6 show that some such restriction is necessary.

blocks.en: We contribute four pieces. First, we introduce complete prompt transcripts and context capacity , an information measure for the data-dependent choices used to construct a prompt. Second, we prove expected and high-probability selected-context validity bounds with leading rate I ⁡ ( T ; S ∣ U ) / k \sqrt{\mathrm{I}(T;S\mid U)/k} , and show the rate is sharp, with an exact constant when log ⁡ k ≪ κ ≪ k \log k\ll\kappa\ll k (Theorems 4.1 , 4.2 , and 4.4 ); the denominator is the selected context length k k , not the store size n n . Third, we extend the calculus to weighted contexts, clustered stores, latent tasks, multi-round prompt editing, and PAC-Bayesian randomized retrieval, whose certificate charges a data-dependent candidate gate its prior mass (Theorem 6.1 ) and has a variance-sensitive form (Theorem 6.2 ). Fourth, we instantiate the penalty in Bayesian linear in-context regression and test the certificates on a real retrieval pipeline and in synthetic and API-backed LLM stress tests. Appendix G names the source of each proof tool.

blocks.en: 2 Related work
blocks.zh: 2 相关工作

blocks.en: Garg et al. [19] showed that transformers trained from scratch can in-context learn simple function classes. Several works argue that trained attention layers can implement optimization or classical estimators in their activations [ 1 , 42 , 21 ] . Recent solvable models give sharp asymptotics for linear attention, task diversity, task alignment, and scaling laws [ 29 , 28 , 5 ] . Our results are complementary: they apply after the in-context learner is fixed and ask whether the chosen context statistically supports the claimed risk.
blocks.zh: Garg 等 (英语). [19] 显示从零开始训练的变压器可以内化学习简单的函数类. 一些著作认为,训练有素的注意力层可以在它们的激活中执行优化或古典估计器[1,42,21]. 最近可溶解的模型为线性关注,任务多样性,任务协调,以及缩放定律提供了尖锐的不对称性[29,28,5]. 我们的结果是相辅相成的:它们适用于校内学习者固定后,并询问选定的背景是否从统计上支持所声称的风险。

blocks.en: RAG theory has begun to model retrieved documents as noisy or query-dependent in-context examples. Guo et al. [20] derive finite-sample risk bounds for retrieval-augmented generation in an in-context linear-regression model. Our model is more agnostic about the frozen predictor and focuses on adaptivity of the context pipeline itself: re-ranking, validation reuse, and model-in-the-loop search may leak information even if each retrieved item is individually relevant.
blocks.zh: RAG理论已经开始将检索到的文件建模为吵闹或依赖查询的内文实例. 郭等编. [20] 以内文本线性递归模型为检索-增强生成获得有限-样本风险界限. 我们的模型对冷冻的预测器更加不可知,并专注于上下文管道本身的适应性:重新排位,验证再利用,模型在即搜索可能泄露信息,即使每个检索到的物品都是个别相关的.

blocks.en: Adaptive data analysis studies how statistics remain valid when queries are selected after observing previous answers [ 14 , 15 , 2 ] . Mutual information bounds control selection bias in adaptive analysis [ 36 ] and learning algorithms [ 46 ] . PAC-Bayes provides another route to data-dependent, nonuniform generalization [ 32 , 10 , 13 ] . We translate these tools to prompt construction and isolate the dependence on context length.
blocks.zh: 适应性数据分析研究了统计如何在观察了先前的答复后选择查询时仍然有效[14,15,2]. 相互信息约束了适应性分析中的控制选择偏差[36]和学习算法[46]. PAC-Bayes提供了另一种依赖数据,非统一通用的路径[32,10,13]. 我们把这些工具翻译为快速构建,隔离对上下文长度的依赖.

blocks.en: Reporting the best of many noisy estimates biases the report upward, the winner’s curse [ 48 ] ; Theorem 4.4 is a winner’s-curse statement for prompts. Simultaneous inference pays a constant valid for every selection rule [ 3 ] , the role κ \kappa plays here in nats, while selective inference conditions on the selection event [ 27 , 18 ] . Reality checks [ 44 ] , leaderboard reuse [ 4 ] , and max-information corrections of p-values [ 35 ] treat related reuse problems. Our object is the selected score itself.

blocks.en: The distinction from applying existing bounds verbatim is the object being certified. If one treats the final prompt as just another data-dependent hypothesis, a mutual-information bound can charge I ⁡ ( T , S ) \mathrm{I}(T;S) , but it does not by itself specify which empirical average is being certified, why the denominator is the selected context length k k rather than the store size n n , or how to account for selected indices, repeated examples, clustered documents, and multi-round prompt edits. The transcript-kernel formulation below makes those choices measurable and exposes the selected-context score as a ghost-sample statistic.

blocks.en: The abstract capacity can be upper bounded from logs produced by standard retrieval systems. Table 2 gives a menu of sufficient accounting rules. Good retrieval reduces approximation error; stable retrieval prevents statistical overclaiming.

blocks.en: 8 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 8 结论

blocks.en: In-context learning is not only about the model inside the prompt; it is also about the process that chose the prompt. We showed that adaptive context selection has a sharp information-theoretic price of order κ / k \sqrt{\kappa/k} . This price composes across prompt-engineering rounds, is unavoidable in the worst case, and leads naturally to stability-regularized retrieval. The theory suggests a simple reporting norm for RAG and few-shot learning: along with context length and retrieval accuracy, report how much information the context construction pipeline was allowed to spend.
blocks.zh: 文中学习不仅涉及快件内部的模型,也涉及选择快件的过程. 我们显示,适应性背景选择具有一个尖锐的信息理论价格 $ / k\ sqrt\kappa/k}。 这种价格是跨越快速工程周期的,在最坏的情况下是不可避免的,自然会导致稳定的正规检索。 该理论为RAG提出了简单的报告规范,也提出了少见的学习:与上下文长度和检索准确性一起,报告允许上下文构造管道花费多少信息.

blocks.en: A.4 Limitations
blocks.zh: A.4 限制

blocks.en: The results are intentionally agnostic to the internals of the in-context learner. They do not characterize when transformers learn an optimal inner algorithm, nor do they replace task-specific analyses for linear attention or softmax attention. Proposition D.21 handles public independent clusters, but stronger corpus dependence would require sharper mixing or graph-dependent concentration. Finally, mutual information can be difficult to compute for continuous prompt transcripts; practical use requires finite-precision logging, randomized retrieval, or PAC-Bayesian upper bounds such as Theorem 6.1 . The synthetic and API-backed experiments are diagnostic, and the Banking77 study (Appendix B.1 ) covers one task and one recipe library; there the certificates are valid but conservative by roughly an order of magnitude relative to the mean gap, the price of validity against the worst case of Theorem 4.4 .

blocks.en: A.5 Broader impact
blocks.zh: A.5 更广泛的影响

blocks.en: The paper studies statistical validity of prompt construction rather than capabilities of any particular model. The positive use case is more honest evaluation of RAG, few-shot learning, and model-in-the-loop prompt engineering: reporting capacity budgets can reduce accidental overclaiming when validation examples are repeatedly reused. A possible misuse is performative certification, where a system reports a small budget while omitting unlogged prompt-engineering rounds. This is why the theory emphasizes transcript logging and split hygiene. The real-LLM stress tests use fictional labels and synthetic task text, and the Banking77 study uses a public benchmark, so no sensitive user data is processed.
blocks.zh: 文件研究的是快速构建的统计有效性,而不是任何特定模型的能力。 正面使用案例是对RAG更诚实的评价,少有镜头的学习,以及模型即时工程:报告能力预算可以在验证实例被反复重复使用时减少意外的超标. 一种可能的误用是绩效认证,即一个系统报告少量预算而省略未记录的快速工程周期。 这就是为什么这个理论强调记录和分卫生。 真-LLM应激测试使用虚构标签和合成任务文本,Bank77研究使用公共基准,因此没有处理敏感的用户数据.

blocks.en: The proof tools are standard, and we name them. Theorem 4.1 is Theorem 1 of Xu and Raginsky [46] applied to the empirical mean of the k k selected examples; this selected-subsample step, which gives the variance proxy σ 2 / k \sigma^{2}/k rather than one normalized by the store size, is its only nonstandard step. Theorem D.19 is an instance of the cumulant bounds of Jiao et al. [24] and Bu et al. [8] . Theorem 4.2 is approximate max-information transfer [ 14 , Thm. 4] conditioned on the query. Proposition 4.5 is the chain rule, and Theorem 4.4 is a Rademacher maximum over a finite class, whose exact constant follows from binomial tails by the method of types [ 11 ] . Theorem 6.1 is fixed- λ \lambda Catoni-form PAC-Bayes [ 10 ] ; we found no counterpart of its gate charge log ⁡ ( 1 / Π u ​ ( 𝒜 ) ) \log(1/\Pi_{u}(\mathcal{A})) phrased for retrieval gating. Theorem 6.2 combines the predictable plug-in supermartingale of Waudby-Smith and Ramdas [43] , built from an inequality of Fan et al. [16] , with the PAC-Bayesian change of measure and a union bound over a finite grid; its countable-library variant (Remark D.27 ) uses the empirical Bernstein inequality of Maurer and Pontil [31] . Proposition D.25 combines the oracle inequality of Theorem 6.1 with Fano’s inequality. Among the closest results, conditional supersample bounds [ 37 ] normalize by the full sample and use data-independent selection bits; variance-calibrated stability [ 17 ] , information bounds for meta-learning [ 25 ] , and second-order PAC-Bayes [ 38 , 33 ] certify learned hypotheses against full-sample averages.

blocks.en: The results can be read as an adaptive-data-analysis theorem specialized to prompt construction, but the specialization is doing statistical work. The transcript includes selected indices, prompt text, validation scores, and model-in-the-loop edits; the empirical quantity being certified is the selected-context average, not an arbitrary population loss of a learned hypothesis. This is what produces the explicit k k dependence and makes repeated demonstrations, clustered chunks, and multi-round prompt edits auditable.
blocks.zh: 其结果可以被解读为适应性-数据分析定理,专门用于快速构建,但该专业正在进行统计工作. 笔录包括选定的指数,即时文本,验证分数,以及即时模式编辑;正在验证的经验量是选定的文本平均值,而不是任意丢失一个学到的假设的人口. 由此产生明确的 k 依赖性, 并使得重复的演示, 分组块, 以及多轮快速编辑可审计 。

blocks.en: The mutual-information capacity is not meant to be estimated by reverse-engineering an opaque RAG system. The practical route is forward accounting: log a prior retriever, candidate gates, temperatures, noisy score releases, and validation reuse. Theorem 6.1 turns the logged KL to the prior, including the prior mass of any data-dependent gate, into a computable certificate term.
blocks.zh: 相互信息能力并不意味着通过逆向工程对不透明的RAG系统进行估计。 实际路线是前方核算:登录前方检索器、候选门、温度、噪音分数释放和验证再利用。 定理6.1将已登录的 KL 转换为前置,包括任何数据依赖门的前置质量,成为可计算证书术语.

blocks.en: The conditional i.i.d. store assumption is the clean base case. Correlated corpora should be blocked, clustered, or evaluated with a fresh holdout; Proposition D.21 gives the simplest effective-block version. Finally, the theory is not pessimistic about useful adaptation: Proposition D.22 separates task-identification information from within-task overfitting, and the linear-regression application shows how good retrieval can improve prediction while still requiring stable certification.
